ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters; estimated dark-to-light ratio of 70:30.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white annular rings and irregular mottling distributed across both lobes, with higher density of high-intensity contiguous patches on the left lobe and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude (2-4 pixel) serrations and deeper irregular notches located on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slight overall convexity from the median notch to the tips, with localized irregularities breaking the smooth curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extremely high density of circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed uniformly across the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive coverage of annular scars (ring marks) likely corresponding to previous sessile organism colonization across more than 60% of the visible fluke area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense 'cookie-cutter' style circular scarring pattern covering nearly the entire trailing half of both lobes.
